map.解析 User-Agent 字符串中的浏览器与设备信息。: Parse browser and device information from a User-Agent string.
map.：UA 通常含浏览器及版本、渲染引擎、操作系统与设备类型标识。: : a UA usually contains browser and version, rendering engine, OS and device-type indicators.
map.：UA 可被随意伪造，各厂商格式不统一，解析结果仅供参考。: : a UA can be freely forged and vendors' formats are inconsistent, so the parse result is for reference only.
map.：浏览器正推进 UA 冻结，逐步改用 Client Hints（Sec-CH-U: : browsers are advancing UA freezing and gradually switching to Client Hints (Sec-CH-UA) for information.
map.点击任意示例可载入解析: Click any example to load and parse
map.现代 UA 都以 \"Mozilla/5.0\" 开头，是浏览器大战时代为兼容旧: Modern UAs all start with "Mozilla/5.0", a "compatibility marker" left from the browser wars to work with old websites, not a real identity.
map.自 2020 年起，Chrome、Firefox、Safari 开始降低 UA: Since 2020, Chrome, Firefox and Safari have reduced UA string precision to protect user privacy (UA Client Hints); new applications should use
map.从 UA 串识别浏览器/系统/设备类型。: Identify browser/OS/device type from a UA string.
map.分析访问日志时识别设备与浏览器分布，据此决定需要兼容哪些版本、是否可以放弃旧浏览: Analyze access logs to identify device and browser distribution, then decide which versions to support and whether old browsers can be dropped.
map.能，UA 仅为客户端自报，不可作身份依据。: Yes, a UA is only client self-reported and cannot be used as identity evidence.
map.为什么识别结果不准？: Why is the identification result inaccurate?
map.因为 UA 字符串本身就是各厂商拼接的混乱历史产物：很多浏览器为兼容性会伪装成其: Because the UA string itself is a messy historical artifact patched together by vendors: many browsers disguise themselves as others for compatibility (e.g., Edge's UA contains Chrome and Safari markers), and Android tablets vs. phones are also hard to distinguish. Therefore UA is only suitable for coarse statistics; precise judgment uses feature detection.
map.User-Agent 解析器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏: User-Agent Parser. Built for developers, runs purely in the frontend; your code never leaves the browser.
